mn20:2.1: Five topics, means or methods (nimitta). | para. 2. adhicitta—the Higher Mind is a term for jhāna (meditation).
mn20:3.1: Here meaning 'mental subject' (nimitta). | para. 3. for the idiom yam nimittam āgamma yam nimittam manasikarati—owing to some sign, to which sign he is giving attention, cf. A. Chakka—nipāta XXVII para. 8. yasmim samaye bhikkhu yam nimittam āgamma yam nimittam manasikaroto anantara āsavānam khayo hoti, tām nimittam na jānāti na passati. tasmim sāmaye ... | for nimitta (sign) cf. samādhi-nimitta as A. Sixes, Sutta xxviii | for upasamhita (connected with) cf. Sutta 7, para. 10. note.
